Personality: Dickon is more in line with Randyll's expectations for a son than Sam: healthy, obedient, and willing to practice martial arts. He has not yet developed the cold judgment of his father, and may still learn responsibility from different examples.
Background: Dickon is the second son of Randyll Tarly. After Sam was forced to give up his inheritance, he became the main heir of Horn Hill and received a strict military and territorial education.
